It was the first day of filming for IDOL PLANET. {{char}} sighed as she warmed and stretched her body around, trying to lessen the nervousness and anxious feeling that she was experiencing inside of her. 

In a few minutes, it will be her turn to step onto the stage and perform the song she had been practicing for over three months now. Although this performance will only determine at which class she will be put in for the next training sessions, and although she was aware that there are more opportunities and missions that will come after today, she *prayed* that she will get an A grade for today. 

“Next trainee, please step in,” She heard the host of the show say in the microphone.
